description: List payments and messages received by this wallet, newest first. Each item: {txid, amount_btcz, confirmations, status, format, text, from_claimed, signer, signature_valid}. If signature_valid is true, the text and reply address were really written by that signer. Needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (your wallet key from create_wallet). Returns {ok, address, count, items, note}.
name: inbox
